dialogues.jp: パチパチパチ……。
dialogues.en: --*clapclapclap*
dialogues.text: --*clapclapclap*

dialogues.jp:
曲が終わった。自分でも気が付かないうちに、
俺は手を叩いていた。
dialogues.en:
The music ended, and without realizing it, my hands
instinctively clapped by themselves.
dialogues.text:
The music ended, and without realizing it, my hands
instinctively clapped by themselves.

dialogues.jp:
「すげえ。すげえよ、３人とも。いや、何てい
　うか、素人離れしてるな……」
dialogues.en:
"That was amazing, you three. You don't sound like amateurs
at all."
dialogues.text:
"That was amazing, you three. You don't sound like amateurs
at all."

dialogues.jp:
ベースとピアノの腹に来る音色に、ことりの軽
やかな歌声が絶妙にマッチしていた。
dialogues.en:
The tone of the bass and piano, accompanied by Kotori's
clear voice, was an amazing match.
dialogues.text:
The tone of the bass and piano, accompanied by Kotori's
clear voice, was an amazing match.

dialogues.jp:
どっしりと落ち着いたリズムに、声が奔放に泳
いでいるって感じなのだ。
dialogues.en:
The vocals sounded like a free spirit among a loud, yet
calming rhythm.
dialogues.text:
The vocals sounded like a free spirit among a loud, yet
calming rhythm.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが言ったように、確かに曲自体も良くて、
耳に心地よいメロディーだった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori herself may not say so, but to me, the entire tune
was a beautiful melody to my ears.
dialogues.text:
Kotori herself may not say so, but to me, the entire tune
was a beautiful melody to my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……準備最終日にして、バッチリ決まっちゃ
　いましたね」
dialogues.en:
"...It's the last day of practice, of course we have to be
perfect."
dialogues.text:
"...It's the last day of practice, of course we have to be
perfect."

dialogues.jp:
お互いの演奏と自信の程を確認するように顔を
見合わせていたことりが、にんまりと笑った。
dialogues.en:
Finally, Kotori gave a smile of confidence. Having just
performed like that, it's not hard to see why.
dialogues.text:
Finally, Kotori gave a smile of confidence. Having just
performed like that, it's not hard to see why.

dialogues.jp:
──してやったり。なんて心の声が聞こえてき
そうな笑顔だ。
dialogues.en:
--"We've done it." I could tell from her smile that her
heart was saying those words to herself.
dialogues.text:
--"We've done it." I could tell from her smile that her
heart was saying those words to herself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「してやったり、だよね」
dialogues.en: "We've done it, haven't we."
dialogues.text: "We've done it, haven't we."

dialogues.jp:
心の見事な連携を見せつつ、弾ける笑顔でふた
りに笑い掛けた。
dialogues.en:
Her mouth co-operating with her heart, her smile seemed
wider than ever.
dialogues.text:
Her mouth co-operating with her heart, her smile seemed
wider than ever.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「今のは良かったね」
dialogues.en: "Great that we did."
dialogues.text: "Great that we did."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「病み上がりの声とは思えなかったな」
dialogues.en: "I can't tell that you were sick in bed just yesterday."
dialogues.text: "I can't tell that you were sick in bed just yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だから、私はそんなにヤワじゃないんだって
　ば」
dialogues.en: "I told you, I'm not as feeble as you think!"
dialogues.text: "I told you, I'm not as feeble as you think!"

dialogues.jp:
昨日までは──必要があったかどうかはさてお
き──ベッドに縛り付けられていたのだ。復帰
初日としては、充分すぎるくらいの歌だった。
dialogues.en:
Having learned her lesson, she had tied herself to bed for
the entire yesterday. As a result, her first day of full
recovery was triumphant.
dialogues.text:
Having learned her lesson, she had tied herself to bed for
the entire yesterday. As a result, her first day of full
recovery was triumphant.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、当日は明日に迫っているのだから、
そうでなくては困るんだけど。
dialogues.en:
Of course, tomorrow being the day of reckoning, it would be
worrying if they weren't ready today.
dialogues.text:
Of course, tomorrow being the day of reckoning, it would be
worrying if they weren't ready today.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、間に合って良かった……」
dialogues.en: "But, I'm glad we made it in time..."
dialogues.text: "But, I'm glad we made it in time..."

dialogues.jp: 胸に手を当て、ほうっと息をつく。
dialogues.en: She put a hand to her chest, and breathed a sigh of relief.
dialogues.text: She put a hand to her chest, and breathed a sigh of relief.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私だけへボへボさんだったら、みんなに申し
　わけが立たなかったところですな」
dialogues.en:
"Having been so sick the last few days, I wasn't sure
whether I could remain on par with the rest of you..."
dialogues.text:
"Having been so sick the last few days, I wasn't sure
whether I could remain on par with the rest of you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もしそんなだったら、学園の勇者になっても
　らうところだったな」
dialogues.en:
"If that was the case, it would've been a situation for the
school's heroine, for sure."
dialogues.text:
"If that was the case, it would've been a situation for the
school's heroine, for sure."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もうそのネタはいいですよ……」
dialogues.en: "Geez, I was kidding about that..."
dialogues.text: "Geez, I was kidding about that..."

dialogues.jp: 俺も小さく笑って。
dialogues.en: We exchanged small smiles.
dialogues.text: We exchanged small smiles.

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、ここは一つ、万歳三唱と行くか」
dialogues.en: "Then, let's give a few cheers of hurray!"
dialogues.text: "Then, let's give a few cheers of hurray!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「は？　万歳？　な、何でですか？」
dialogues.en: "Hah? Hurray? W, why?"
dialogues.text: "Hah? Hurray? W, why?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「こういうことに理由はないの。ほらほら、み
　んな。お手を拝借」
dialogues.en: "No real reason. Come on everyone, join your hands!"
dialogues.text: "No real reason. Come on everyone, join your hands!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それは、一本締めとかに言う言葉だと思いま
　すけど……」
dialogues.en: "That isn't very convincing..."
dialogues.text: "That isn't very convincing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「気にしない、んなことは。ほら、ばんざーい！
　ばんざーい！」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it. C'mon, Hurray! Hurray!"
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it. C'mon, Hurray! Hurray!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ば、ばんざ〜い……」
dialogues.en: "H, hurray..."
dialogues.text: "H, hurray..."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ばんざ〜い……」
dialogues.en: "Hurray..."
dialogues.text: "Hurray..."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ばんざ〜い……」
dialogues.en: "Hurray..."
dialogues.text: "Hurray..."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ばんざーい！」
dialogues.en: "Hurray!!"
dialogues.text: "Hurray!!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「あのう……盛り上がってるところ申しわけな
　いんですが」
dialogues.en: "Um... sorry for interrupting your...cheers..."
dialogues.text: "Um... sorry for interrupting your...cheers..."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「時間も過ぎてるし、そろそろ交替してもらい
　たいんですけど……」
dialogues.en:
"But your allocated time for the room is up, and it's our
turn now..."
dialogues.text:
"But your allocated time for the room is up, and it's our
turn now..."

dialogues.jp:
対抗馬──音楽部の奴ら？　──に対する心理
的圧迫は効果があっただろうか？
dialogues.en:
Rivals in reserving the music room? In other words, maybe we
should give them a few psychological blows?
dialogues.text:
Rivals in reserving the music room? In other words, maybe we
should give them a few psychological blows?

dialogues.jp:
万歳しちゃうくらいバッチリだったぜ──とい
う｛しい／示威｝な両手を下ろし、俺はうなずいた。
dialogues.en:
Of course, a chant of hurray like we just did should be
proof enough. I nodded to him.
dialogues.text:
Of course, a chant of hurray like we just did should be
proof enough. I nodded to him.

dialogues.jp: 「了解」
dialogues.en: "Understood."
dialogues.text: "Understood."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「ことり、今日ってこの後、あの場所に行って、
　歌の練習するつもり？」
dialogues.en:
"Kotori, will you still be going there to practice singing
today?"
dialogues.text:
"Kotori, will you still be going there to practice singing
today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　うん、そうだよ」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ah, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ah, yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「止めておいた方がいいよ。風に当たるのは、
　良くないから」
dialogues.en:
"Maybe you should stop it for today... standing in the wind
like that may be bad for you, just one day before."
dialogues.text:
"Maybe you should stop it for today... standing in the wind
like that may be bad for you, just one day before."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え、え〜……そんな、海辺に｛たたず／佇｝む｛たそがれ／黄昏｝な女性
　じゃあるまいし……」
dialogues.en:
"E, Eh~... I'm not some girl standing at the beach in
twilight or anything, the wind doesn't blow much there..."
dialogues.text:
"E, Eh~... I'm not some girl standing at the beach in
twilight or anything, the wind doesn't blow much there..."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「海辺じゃなくたって、春は風が強いんだから。
　ね」
dialogues.en: "Regardless, the springs winds are pretty strong."
dialogues.text: "Regardless, the springs winds are pretty strong."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん……それもそうだねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Uhhn.... I guess so..."
dialogues.text: "Uhhn.... I guess so..."

dialogues.jp:
ともちゃんは、心配そうに眉じりを下げている。
加勢する事にした。
dialogues.en:
Tomo-chan lowered her eyebrow of worry, having seemed to
have convinced Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Tomo-chan lowered her eyebrow of worry, having seemed to
have convinced Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、さっきあれだけ出来たんだから、今日は
　もう止めておけば？」
dialogues.en: "Well, let's stop going for today, then?"
dialogues.text: "Well, let's stop going for today, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうですね」
dialogues.en: "Yep, you both are right."
dialogues.text: "Yep, you both are right."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、今からみんなで“花より団子”に行か
　ない？　迷惑掛けたお礼におごるから」
dialogues.en:
"Then, why don't we all go to "Hana Yori Dango"? I'd treat
everyone for being such trouble the last few days."
dialogues.text:
"Then, why don't we all go to "Hana Yori Dango"? I'd treat
everyone for being such trouble the last few days."

dialogues.jp:
その言葉に、ともちゃんとみっくんは顔を見合
わせた。と、同時に首を振る。
dialogues.en:
At her suggestion, Tomo-chan and Mik-kun looked at each
other at the same time, then looked back at us and shook
their heads.
dialogues.text:
At her suggestion, Tomo-chan and Mik-kun looked at each
other at the same time, then looked back at us and shook
their heads.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、私達はいいから。ふたりで行きなよ」
dialogues.en: "No thanks, we have things to do. You two go."
dialogues.text: "No thanks, we have things to do. You two go."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「え？　ふたりって、俺とことりの事？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Don't tell me you're, Kotori and I..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? Don't tell me you're, Kotori and I..."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「そうですよ」
dialogues.en: "Yep!"
dialogues.text: "Yep!"

dialogues.jp: 当たり前じゃないですか、とみっくんが笑う。
dialogues.en: Her laugh gave off an "of course!" aura.
dialogues.text: Her laugh gave off an "of course!" aura.

dialogues.jp: 「え〜と……何で？」
dialogues.en: "Ehm... why?"
dialogues.text: "Ehm... why?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「ことりのお金がもったいないからです。じゃ、
　行こ、ともちゃん」
dialogues.en:
"Let's just say we're not worthy of a treat from Kotori.
Let's go, Tomo-chan."
dialogues.text:
"Let's just say we're not worthy of a treat from Kotori.
Let's go, Tomo-chan."

dialogues.speaker: TOmo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、お先に」
dialogues.en: "Then we'd make a move first."
dialogues.text: "Then we'd make a move first."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあね、ふたりとも」
dialogues.en: "Later, you two!"
dialogues.text: "Later, you two!"

dialogues.jp:
ととと、と小走りに遠ざかる背中を、しばし呆
然と見送った。
dialogues.en:
They left us dumbfounded, staring at their backs as their
disappeared into the horizon.
dialogues.text:
They left us dumbfounded, staring at their backs as their
disappeared into the horizon.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……行きましょうか。せっかく、気を利かせ
　てくれたみたいだから」
dialogues.en:
"...We should move as well. I don't want to disappoint the
two of them."
dialogues.text:
"...We should move as well. I don't want to disappoint the
two of them."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、何だか、当たり前みたいな感じになっ
　て来ちゃいましたねえ」
dialogues.en:
"But, somehow, I don't think it's obvious at all that that
would happen..."
dialogues.text:
"But, somehow, I don't think it's obvious at all that that
would happen..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何が？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What would?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What would?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんな風にして、一緒に居る事が、です」
dialogues.en: "Like it is now, us together..."
dialogues.text: "Like it is now, us together..."

dialogues.jp: 横顔をすっと盗み見る。
dialogues.en: I glanced at her from the side.
dialogues.text: I glanced at her from the side.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、桜の向こうの明るい空を透かし見る
ように、遠い目を正面に向けていた。
dialogues.en:
She was looking far into the distance, not looking at
anything in particular as the sakura petals flit past her
view constantly.
dialogues.text:
She was looking far into the distance, not looking at
anything in particular as the sakura petals flit past her
view constantly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何だか、不思議ですよね。ちょっと前までは、
　こんな風じゃなかったのに……」
dialogues.en: "It's so strange, to be talking about it like this..."
dialogues.text: "It's so strange, to be talking about it like this..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ……そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, yes..."
dialogues.text: "Well, yes..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ねえ、朝倉君……」
dialogues.en: "...Hey, Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "...Hey, Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: ことりがこちらに顔を向ける。
dialogues.en: Kotori turned to face me.
dialogues.text: Kotori turned to face me.

dialogues.jp: 妙に、寂しげな笑顔だった。
dialogues.en:
She had a strange smile that seemed to give the impression
that she was...lonely.
dialogues.text:
She had a strange smile that seemed to give the impression
that she was...lonely.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「この前……みっくんに、お兄ちゃんが居るっ
　て……そう言ったでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Earlier... I've told you that Mik-kun has a brother,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"Earlier... I've told you that Mik-kun has a brother,
right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ……みっくんって名前の元になった人な」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... the one who gave Mik-kun the name she has now."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... the one who gave Mik-kun the name she has now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私ね……昔、お兄ちゃんって存在が、うらや
　ましかったんです」
dialogues.en:
"When we were kids... I was kinda jealous of Mik-kun,
because she had an older brother."
dialogues.text:
"When we were kids... I was kinda jealous of Mik-kun,
because she had an older brother."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「へえ……まあ、確かに、きょうだいは居たほ
　うが楽し──」
dialogues.en: "Heh... in the end, it's always more fun to have a sibli--"
dialogues.text: "Heh... in the end, it's always more fun to have a sibli--"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ことりには暦先生が居るじゃんか」
dialogues.en: "Wait, you do have Koyomi-sensei, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "Wait, you do have Koyomi-sensei, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私ね、思うんですけど……」
dialogues.en: "I kind of think..."
dialogues.text: "I kind of think..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「同性の兄弟姉妹って、難しいと思うんだよね。
　色々と……」
dialogues.en:
"That siblings of the same sex, it's more difficult for
them..."
dialogues.text:
"That siblings of the same sex, it's more difficult for
them..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "You... think?"
dialogues.text: "You... think?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりはこくりとうなずくと、再び視線を遠く
にやった。
dialogues.en: Kotori nodded, and returned her gaze to the distance.
dialogues.text: Kotori nodded, and returned her gaze to the distance.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、何て言うのかな……」
dialogues.en: "Well, how do you say it..."
dialogues.text: "Well, how do you say it..."

dialogues.jp:
もどかしい言葉を押し出すように、手をぐるぐ
ると回す。
dialogues.en:
Getting impatient with herself, she gestured with her hand
round and round.
dialogues.text:
Getting impatient with herself, she gestured with her hand
round and round.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「弟や妹が｛・・・・・・・・・・／後から割り込んできた｝って言うのか
　な。そういう気持ちを抱くと思うの……」
dialogues.en:
"In the other case, you find that there's more of a chance
that the older person will look out for the younger one, and
such...
dialogues.text:
"In the other case, you find that there's more of a chance
that the older person will look out for the younger one, and
such...

dialogues.jp: その気持ちは分かった。
dialogues.en: I certainly understood those feelings.
dialogues.text: I certainly understood those feelings.

dialogues.jp:
昔、そんな感情を、音夢に対して抱いた事があっ
たから……。
dialogues.en: Way before, that's the same way I felt about Nemu...
dialogues.text: Way before, that's the same way I felt about Nemu...

dialogues.jp:
ことりって、結構鋭いところがあるのかもしれ
ない。人間観察において。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's probably a better judge of people than I figured
her for.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's probably a better judge of people than I figured
her for.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それが異性だったら、そんな事はないのかも
　……って思ったりしたんだけど……」
dialogues.en:
"And that's for opposite sex siblnigs... for same sex... I
don't think so..."
dialogues.text:
"And that's for opposite sex siblnigs... for same sex... I
don't think so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやあ……そうでもないと思うぜ」
dialogues.en: "...No, I don't think that's true."
dialogues.text: "...No, I don't think that's true."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "You think so?"
dialogues.text: "You think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「たぶんな」
dialogues.en: "More or less."
dialogues.text: "More or less."

dialogues.jp: 自分を｛かんが／鑑｝みるに。
dialogues.en: Not from my own experience, but...
dialogues.text: Not from my own experience, but...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そうかもしれませんね」
dialogues.en: "...I guess that may be so."
dialogues.text: "...I guess that may be so."

dialogues.jp:
ふうとため息をつくと、それまでとは変わって、
さばさばとした口調で言った。
dialogues.en:
She gave a short sigh, then her overall demeanour started
changing.
dialogues.text:
She gave a short sigh, then her overall demeanour started
changing.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「結局、お兄ちゃんは出来なかったけど、でも、
　いいです。朝倉君と仲良くなれたから」
dialogues.en:
"In any case, there's no way I can have an older brother
now. But it's okay, since I'm close to you."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, there's no way I can have an older brother
now. But it's okay, since I'm close to you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「こんなに仲良しになれた男の子って、朝倉君
　が初めてなんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"You're the first guy I've ever been so close with, in
fact."
dialogues.text:
"You're the first guy I've ever been so close with, in
fact."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、そうなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, really?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何か〜……意外そうですね」
dialogues.en: "What~ Is that surprising?"
dialogues.text: "What~ Is that surprising?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、何となく」
dialogues.en: "Well, sort of."
dialogues.text: "Well, sort of."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとですよ？」
dialogues.en: "But it's true, you know?"
dialogues.text: "But it's true, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「手紙や電話の向こう側の人じゃない……パパッ
　と告白して、パパッと背中を向けてしまう人
　でもない……」
dialogues.en:
"There's no guy I've called or written letters to... no guy
who my heart beated faster for, who I wanted to confess
to..."
dialogues.text:
"There's no guy I've called or written letters to... no guy
who my heart beated faster for, who I wanted to confess
to..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「こんな風に、きちんと向き合ったのって、朝
　倉君が最初なんですからね」
dialogues.en:
"But just talking like this face to face, you're the first
guy I've ever done this with."
dialogues.text:
"But just talking like this face to face, you're the first
guy I've ever done this with."

dialogues.jp:
それが大事な点なんです──とでも言うように、
唇に人差し指を置く。
dialogues.en:
She placed her finger on her lips in thought-- I guess to
her, this was a big thing.
dialogues.text:
She placed her finger on her lips in thought-- I guess to
her, this was a big thing.

dialogues.jp: まるで、大切な秘密を解き明かしたかのように。
dialogues.en: As if she's just explained a big secret she's been keeping.
dialogues.text: As if she's just explained a big secret she's been keeping.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あっ、ほら、やった、人、あんまり居ないみ
　たいです」
dialogues.en: "Hey look! There isn't many people around."
dialogues.text: "Hey look! There isn't many people around."

dialogues.jp: ことりが俺の手を引き、人混みを走り出す。
dialogues.en: Kotori grabbed my hand and started walking.
dialogues.text: Kotori grabbed my hand and started walking.

dialogues.jp: 「う？　こ、ことり。手」
dialogues.en: "Uh? K, Kotori, your hand..."
dialogues.text: "Uh? K, Kotori, your hand..."

dialogues.jp: 慌てて俺も走り出しながら、言う。
dialogues.en: In confusion, I let myself be dragged as I talked.
dialogues.text: In confusion, I let myself be dragged as I talked.

dialogues.jp:
意識は全部、ことりとつないだ手に集中してい
る。
dialogues.en:
All I could concentrate on was the fact that Kotori was
holding my hand.
dialogues.text:
All I could concentrate on was the fact that Kotori was
holding my hand.

dialogues.jp: あたたかいとか、やわらかいとか。
dialogues.en: It was warm, it was soft.
dialogues.text: It was warm, it was soft.

dialogues.jp: そんなことすら考えられない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't think of anything else.
dialogues.text: I couldn't think of anything else.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、ことりと手をつないでいるというその事
実が、俺の中を駆けめぐり、鼓動を加速させた。
dialogues.en:
Something was running circles inside my stomach, and my
heartbeat jumped several notches.
dialogues.text:
Something was running circles inside my stomach, and my
heartbeat jumped several notches.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは走りながら振り返ると、何だか｛まぶ／眩｝しい
くらいの笑顔を浮かべながら言った。
dialogues.en:
Kotori stopped and turned back to me, and gave me a dazzling
smile.
dialogues.text:
Kotori stopped and turned back to me, and gave me a dazzling
smile.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いいじゃないですか。ふたりは、仲良しさん
　なんだから」
dialogues.en: "It's okay. We're good friends, after all!"
dialogues.text: "It's okay. We're good friends, after all!"

dialogues.jp:
ことりの頬が、俺に負けず劣らず、真っ赤になっ
て見えるのは気のせいだろうか。
dialogues.en: Kotori's cheeks, just like mine, were flushed with redness.
dialogues.text: Kotori's cheeks, just like mine, were flushed with redness.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの手から、ことりの早鐘を打つ鼓動が聞
こえてきそうだった。
dialogues.en:
I felt like I could almost hear her own quickening heartbeat
through her hand...
dialogues.text:
I felt like I could almost hear her own quickening heartbeat
through her hand...

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの人間観察◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Reading of People◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Reading of People◆

dialogues.jp:
ことり達の演奏は、素晴らしい仕上がりを見せ
ていた。
dialogues.en: The trio's final practice session ended magnificently.
dialogues.text: The trio's final practice session ended magnificently.

dialogues.jp:
帰り。ことりと俺は、喫茶“花より団子”に行っ
た。
dialogues.en:
As we returned, Kotori and I went to the "Hana Yori Dango"
coffeeshop.
dialogues.text:
As we returned, Kotori and I went to the "Hana Yori Dango"
coffeeshop.

dialogues.jp:
途中、ことりから、兄弟についての考察を聞か
された。
dialogues.en: On the way, Kotori talked to me about siblings.
dialogues.text: On the way, Kotori talked to me about siblings.

dialogues.jp: ことりって、結構鋭いのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: I never knew Kotori was this sharp about people.
dialogues.text: I never knew Kotori was this sharp about people.
